requires host

  • CURIE: gmeow:requiresHost
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/requiresHost
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Asserts whether a reference frame requires a hosting entity to exist.

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:ReferenceFrame -> xsd:boolean; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:requiresHost from gmeow:ReferenceFrame to xsd:boolean when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    gmeow:hasAxis       ex:narrativeOrder ;
    gmeow:dimensionCount "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ;

    gmeow:determinacyModel gmeow:determinacyDisputed .

    gmeow:narrativeTimeAxis gmeow:axisDiscourseTime ;
    gmeow:discourseTimeOf ex:novel ;
    gmeow:frameRealm     gmeow:frameRealmNarrative ;
    gmeow:hasAxis        ex:narrativeOrder ;
    gmeow:dimensionCount "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ;
    gmeow:frameKind      gmeow:frameKindNarrative ;
    gmeow:requiresHost   false ;
    gmeow:determinacyModel gmeow:determinacyDisputed .

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:ReferenceFrame

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to assert whether a reference frame needs a hosting entity to exist; functional boolean.

Avoid when

  • Avoid naming the host here (use gmeow:isHostedBy) — this flag only states whether a host is required.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:requiresHost true for frames bound to a host (a robot base, a building grid) and pair with gmeow:isHostedBy on instances.

Examples

  • gmeow:referenceFrameRobotArm6DOF gmeow:requiresHost true.
